title: Random Number
text: Generate normally distributed random numbers, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Seed} sets Starting seed; {Mean}, {Variance}, {Sample time} sets the time between intervals and {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} treats vectors as 1-D. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Mean
params.values: Mean of random numbers 0 (default) | scalar | array

params.name: Variance
params.values: Variance of random numbers 1 (default) | scalar | array

params.name: Seed
params.values: Starting seed 0 (default) | positive integer | scalar | array
